caption: The drawing depicts a yellow elaborately decorated dresser with an attached mirror. The dresser features four main drawers at the bottom, each adorned with detailed brown handles and intricate scrollwork in a darker brown shade. Above the drawers, there are two small rectangular compartments on either side, each with a round brown knob and additional brown detailing. The mirror, centered at the top, is rectangular with rounded upper corners and is bordered by a decorative yellow and brown frame that includes swirling patterns and pointed finials at the top. On each side of the mirror, there are elevated platelike platforms supporting turned brown ornaments that resemble candlesticks or finials, with additional brown finial-like forms extending along the upper edges. The dresser rests on short rounded feet at the bottom, and the entire piece is rendered with attention to shadow, giving a subtle sense of depth. The colors are primarily soft yellow with brown accents and highlights. The artist has signed the drawing in the lower right corner with the name "Cordena Jackson."
title: Dresser
